camel_example: aliyun iot UpdateProduct --region cn-hangzhou --ProductName '路灯' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_en: Modifies the information of a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口修改指定产品的信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-product --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --product-name '路灯' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProduct

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The product description. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as one character
parameters.help_zh: 描述产品信息。长度不超过100个字符。一个中文算一个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product. This is the globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the product.

You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
产品的ProductKey，物联网平台为产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html接口，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The new product name.
The product name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). A Chinese character counts as two characters.

<notice> The product name must be unique within the current instance.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的产品名称。
产品名称长度为4~30个字符，可以包含中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_）。一个中文汉字算2个字符。

<notice> 产品名称在当前实例下需保持唯一。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_name
